text:
dina: Quick sync: we need a clean, low-friction recruitment flow for the next Design Partner beta (private + dedicated). Problem: partners keep asking for deep infra changes; we want to avoid that. Can we finalize acceptance gates + success metrics today?

omar: Proposal: 8 seats, two-week engagement, single POC, <=3 hours total time. Require partners to run a tiny smoke suite (3 prompts) and opt-in to redacted traces.

lina: Add a one-line "out-of-scope" section in the invite: no custom quant permutations, no kernel or runtime code changes, and no infra swaps. Call it out bold in the first paragraph. Saves time.

ben: Incentive model: $350 stipend + $1k infra credit for Dedicated. Also include a free 45m tuning session post-beta and a short perf summary. That helps justify the ask.

sam: Measurement plan suggestion: 1) onboarding run of 3 canonical prompts, 2) end-run of same 3 prompts, 3) short 6-question form + optional 30m interview. Analysis: embedding sim delta, human acceptability (1-5), and latency 95p.

qa-bot: Reminder: ensure we capture a redacted request/response sample for each partner at both timepoints and label them with partner id.

dina: Success criteria (draft): onboard >=6 partners, 95p latency <=300ms on our dedicated baseline, median embedding sim >=0.9 on canonical prompts, and at least one product or config change implemented post-beta.
lina: Add a risk gate: if any partner reports a P0 regression vs their baseline, pause new onboarding until triage.

omar: Opt-in telemetry: partners must opt into redacted traces. For partners who decline, we still accept them but without dashboard metrics (they get the post-beta summary in text).

ben: Invite blurb draft: 
```
Join our 2-week private Design Partner beta (8 seats). You'll get $350 + $1k infra credit, a 30-60m onboarding call, and a post-beta tuning session. Requirements: single POC, run a 3-prompt smoke test at start and end, and opt-in to share redacted traces. Out of scope: custom quantizations, kernel/runtime changes, infra swaps.
```

sam: Also include a tiny section "How we measure" so partners know it's low lift: run three exemplar prompts, fill a short form, optional interview. We compute embed sim + human acceptability + latency distribution.

qa-bot: Note: bulk invite rate limit = 420/hr. Schedule sends staggered to avoid throttling.

dina: Action items: Omar -> finalize invite copy and legal blurb, Lina -> place the bold OOS line and time-commitment estimate, Ben -> confirm stipend/credits and tuning offer, Sam -> assemble canonical prompts + short form, QA-bot -> provide the smoke-suite template. I'll send invites Fri AM after a quick pass in #product-review.

ben: One more ask: include an "expected outcomes" bullet so partners know what they'll receive (perf summary, tuning notes, optional observability access). Helps conversion.

dina: Great. If there are no objections, we'll lock this and prepare a short FAQ for common negotiation asks. Thanks everyone.
